hypothesis: For an explicit image-horizontal position word about the subject, the inherited listener and the projected camera measurement may encode the same cue with different reliabilities. On fixed physical candidates replace the listener's binary word likelihood with a source-calibrated camera likelihood, comparing directly with adding the same evidence.
baseline: Registered simplified v1, four subject slots and two rounds, source epoch100, PCA boxes. All arms choose the same four original boxes. Per-input execution with the original sentence and one deterministic horizontal-word counterfactual. No target training, external experts or FINAL.
language: Conservative text-only matcher for an absolute horizontal phrase in the subject's main description or its explicit position field. Flip identified left/right tokens only. Ambiguous signs, relational/object-relative clauses and absent fields fall back. The edit must be involutive. No edits to this matcher based on model scores or evaluation labels.
calibration: Each source's original 640 natural fit annotations estimate one nonnegative slope for P(right|u)=sigmoid(k*(2*u-1)) using visible normalized projected centers, symmetric intercept zero, labels from the factual text. MAP slope uses fixed Gaussian prior SD=10 and no target labels. Source's ordinary calibration split held out by recording. Report coverage, sign accuracy, binary cross-entropy and the constant-half control on annotated centers.
common_space: Four original subject anchors. Each counterfactual retains the same point draw, reads the edited sentence and uses its own registered reference computation. Evaluate its overlap-vote priors at the four original physical anchors and feed these anchors through the original joint decoder. Do not match query indices. For the original condition, verify the same anchor scoring calculation reproduces the registered readout. Restrict treatment to slots with positive counterfactual overlap and a visible projected center. Keep all other original probability mass; less than two comparable slots falls back.
replacement: On comparable slots normalize actual and flipped logit vectors separately, calling them q, r. The balanced binary intervention assigns joint masses q_i/2 and r_i/2. Thus m_i=(q_i+r_i)/2 and implicit likelihood l_i=q_i/(q_i+r_i). Replacement is normalize(m_i*f_i), identical to normalize(q_i*f_i/l_i). f_i is the source camera probability for the factual sign. Addition is normalize(q_i*f_i). The balanced alternative phrase is an intervention; independence between phrase and other clues is an approximation. The original selected slate can depend on the factual sign. Claims are conditional on that slate.
controls: add receives the same observations and physical likelihood and uses the factual listener. balanced_only uses both sentences without geometry. reverse_camera inverts only the physical sign. wrong_slot permutes the entire counterfactual distribution among comparable slots in one frame by a deterministic seeded nonidentity cycle. camera_only uses the physical likelihood and a uniform prior within the same comparable mass.
scope: Start with calibration accuracy and actual predictions on all 384 source held-out rows (Waymo 160, Drone 64, Quad 160). Precommit a separate cross-platform pilot on the historical ordinary 3,072 input roster (512 per direction), even for source ties provided the aggregate heldout label log loss improves on log(2) and some slates can compare. Publish all six arms against v1 and each other including every fallback. Extend, unchanged, to 18,620 ordinary validation only if the pilot replacement beats both v1 and the direct addition in macro Acc@50, beats wrong-slot in that metric, and rescues outnumber harms vs v1. Report recording group dependence. Retain v1 until both evaluated stages and simpler controls support the mechanism.
measurement: Primary strict oriented Acc@50. Also Acc@25, mIoU, paired rescues and harms, per-source/direction plus all records, candidate coverage, point/box and prediction parity, stage timing and paired recording bootstrap. Labels for final task scoring opened only after all predictions in their stage have been sealed. Source GT coordinates are used solely for fitting and auditing the word likelihood. Public artifacts anonymized.
